Cards Total | 154 |- ! Card Size | 63x88mm |} '''Reflections II: Expanding the Galaxy''' is the 28th Star Wars CCG product, published by Decipher on 10 January 2001. It is 154 cards (77 per side): 34 very rare foils, 62 super rare foils, 4 ultra rare foils, and 54 premium cards, plus five foil box/case toppers. Packs are 18 cards, MSRP $4.95, 30 packs per box. Each pack has '''one foil''' from the list below, two unique premiums (listed under Card list), and random reprints. Those reprints are not listed. Some packs did not contain a Japanese card. A foil of a title that is not on this list (and is not one of the box/case toppers) is not a Decipher Reflections II pack foil.[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive] == Packaging == {| class="wikitable" style="background:transparent; border:none;" |- style="background:transparent; border:none; vertical-align:bottom;" | style="border:none; text-align:center;" | [[File:Reflections-II-display.png|260px|Reflections II display]]
''Display'' | style="border:none; text-align:center;" | [[File:Reflections-II-pack.png|200px|Reflections II pack]]
''18-card pack'' |} == Box toppers == Displays shipped with foil '''box toppers''' of Enhanced Premiere characters, plus a Japanese [[Darth Vader]] '''case topper'''. These titles also appear on the foil print sheets (two copies per sheet) and are playable foils: * [[Boba Fett With Blaster Rifle]] * [[Han With Heavy Blaster Pistol]] * [[Leia With Blaster Rifle]] * [[Obi-Wan With Lightsaber]] * Japanese [[Darth Vader (Japanese Reflections II Foil)|Darth Vader]] (case topper) == Japanese-language foils == Complete Card List v4 marks six Reflections II pack/case foils as Japanese-language printings. [[Darth Vader (Japanese Reflections II Foil)|Darth Vader]] is the case topper. The others are pack foils listed below. These are Japanese-language foils inside Reflections II, not a Japanese Reflections set.[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/swccgcardlist4.0.pdf Star Wars Customizable Card Game Complete Card List v4.0], p. 30–31. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261009184033/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/swccgcardlist4.0.pdf Internet Archive]. * [[Darth Vader (Japanese Reflections II Foil)|Darth Vader]] (R10, P, case topper) * [[Death Star (Japanese Reflections II Foil)|Death Star]] (R32, SR) * [[Imperial Walker (Japanese Reflections II Foil)|Imperial Walker]] (R49, SR) * [[Brainiac (Japanese Reflections II Foil)|Brainiac]] (R56, SR) * [[Leia (Japanese Reflections II Foil)|Leia]] (R63, SR) * [[Rebel Snowspeeder (Japanese Reflections II Foil)|Rebel Snowspeeder]] (R104, SR) == Memorabilia == The booster box held a fold-out Rules Supplement (Expanded Universe notes, combo-card rules, and the collector's card list): {| class="wikitable" style="background:transparent; border:none;" |- style="background:transparent; vertical-align:top;" | style="border:none; text-align:center;" | [[File:Reflections-II-rules-supplement-front.png|360px|Reflections II rules supplement front]]
''Rules side'' | style="border:none; text-align:center;" | [[File:Reflections-II-rules-supplement-back.png|360px|Reflections II rules supplement back]]
''Card list'' |} == Print sheets == Foils and premiums are 11×11 (121 cards). Light foil sheet: 3 box toppers 2×, 1 ultra rare, 15 very rare 3×, 34 super rare 2×, 1 blank. Dark foil sheet: 1 case topper 2×, 1 box topper 2×, 1 ultra rare, 19 very rare 3×, 28 super rare 2×, 1 blank. Premium sheet: 27 titles (15 four times and 12 five times) plus 1 blank. == Possible foils == 100 pack foils: 34 very rare, 62 super rare, 4 ultra rare ([[Luke Skywalker, Jedi Knight]] Light; == Physical foil source, 14 November 2026 ==
Bill requested an actual foil publication as the Premiere overview's Reflections II example. The photographed card was independently read: unique, destiny 5, Lost Interrupt, no expansion symbol, English text and ©2000 copyright. The PSA holder identifies Reflections II foil and certificate 84897751. The original Decipher checklist independently identifies Don't Get Cocky as a Premiere super-rare diffraction-foil reprint. Printed text was transcribed from the actual card rather than copied from the ordinary Premiere article. The complete source photograph was archived and its bytes matched.
